# n64dk command reference

Every command, its arguments and defaults, read from the parsers themselves. Global option:
`--format text|json` goes before the command name (`n64dk --format json info ROM`).

164 commands.

| command | what it does |
|---|---|
| [`abi-solve`](#abi-solve) | Infer prototypes for every catalogued function from callee and call-site evidence |
| [`address-explain`](#address-explain) | Explain a catalogue or linked VRAM in a logical image |
| [`agent-order`](#agent-order) | Write the model stage's work order for one function (no model is called) |
| [`agent-stage`](#agent-stage) | Model stage: an agent loop per unresolved function, accepted only by strict verification |
| [`agent-tools`](#agent-tools) | Tool protocol for a model or person matching one function: dis, draft, try, exact, info, regdump, neighbours, boundary |
| [`asm-query`](#asm-query) | Search normalized opcode sequences and delay-slot forms across projects |
| [`asm-score`](#asm-score) | Score candidate code against target code with asm-differ/permuter penalties |
| [`assets-scan`](#assets-scan) | Find compressed streams and loader-referenced ROM ranges; write an interval ledger |
| [`audio`](#audio) | Audio inventory: libaudio ctl/tbl, MIDI, libmus, seqfile banks; byte-exact intervals |
| [`automation-serve`](#automation-serve) | Execute newline-delimited JSON operation requests on standard input |
| [`blind-check`](#blind-check) | Verify that no forbidden source tree or donor is reachable from a blind run's configuration; write a digest-sealed isolation receipt (read-only) |
| [`boot-emu`](#boot-emu) | Emulate the entry code and map the loaded RAM image back to its ROM sources |

## abi-solve

Infer prototypes for every catalogued function from callee and call-site evidence

```text
n64dk abi-solve image [--vram-delta VRAM_DELTA] --catalogue CATALOGUE [--catalogue-shift CATALOGUE_SHIFT] [--show SHOW] [--function NAME_OR_ADDRESS] [--min-confidence MIN_CONFIDENCE] [--out OUT]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` (positional) | `image` | yes |  | ROM or linear image |
| `--vram-delta` | `VRAM_DELTA` |  |  | VRAM minus file offset (omit for a ROM with a boot segment) |
| `--catalogue` | `CATALOGUE` | yes |  | function catalogue TOML or symbol_addrs.txt |
| `--catalogue-shift` | `CATALOGUE_SHIFT` |  | `` |  |
| `--show` | `SHOW` |  | `30` | how many flagged rows to list (a count) |
| `--function` | `NAME_OR_ADDRESS` |  |  | report one catalogued function only: its name, or its address in hex or decimal |
| `--min-confidence` | `MIN_CONFIDENCE` |  | `0.8` |  |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  |  | write confident declarations to this header (m2c context seed) |

## agent-stage

Model stage: an agent loop per unresolved function, accepted only by strict verification

```text
n64dk agent-stage [--project PROJECT] [--state STATE] [--function FUNCTION] [--list LIST] [--remaining REMAINING] [--provider {command,dry-run,none}] [--transcript TRANSCRIPT] [--attempts ATTEMPTS] [--seconds SECONDS] [--tool-calls TOOL_CALLS] [--total-seconds TOTAL_SECONDS]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  | `'.'` |  |
| `--state` | `STATE` |  |  |  |
| `--function` | `FUNCTION` |  |  | IMAGE:ADDR[:SIZE] (repeatable) |
| `--list` | `LIST` |  |  | TSV: image, address, [true size] |
| `--remaining` | `REMAINING` |  |  | take this many remaining functions from the inventory |
| `--provider` | `{command,dry-run,none}` |  |  | default: the configured command |
| `--transcript` | `TRANSCRIPT` |  |  | dry-run: recorded transcript JSON |
| `--attempts` | `ATTEMPTS` |  | `2` |  |
| `--seconds` | `SECONDS` |  | `1800.0` |  |
| `--tool-calls` | `TOOL_CALLS` |  | `80` |  |
| `--total-seconds` | `TOTAL_SECONDS` |  | `` |  |

## agent-tools

Tool protocol for a model or person matching one function: dis, draft, try, exact, info, regdump, neighbours, boundary

```text
n64dk agent-tools {dis,draft,try,exact,info,regdump,neighbours,boundary} [files ...] [--session SESSION] [--project PROJECT] [--state STATE] [--image IMAGE] [--function FUNCTION] [--size SIZE] [--flags FLAGS] [--pipe PIPE] [--show SHOW] [--lines LINES] [--count COUNT]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tool` (positional) | `{dis,draft,try,exact,info,regdump,neighbours,boundary}` | yes |  |  |
| `files` (positional) | `[files ...]` |  |  |  |
| `--session` | `SESSION` |  |  | a model-stage work folder's session.json (function, project, budget) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  | `'.'` |  |
| `--state` | `STATE` |  |  | state folder (default <project>/.n64dk/agent) |
| `--image` | `IMAGE` |  |  |  |
| `--function` | `FUNCTION` |  |  | real address (hex) or catalogue name |
| `--size` | `SIZE` |  |  | true size: verify a repaired range starting at the address |
| `--flags` | `FLAGS` |  |  | compiler flags replacing the recipe's (write --flags='-O2 ...') |
| `--pipe` | `PIPE` |  |  | lane, e.g. kmc+builtin, kmc+asn64, ido5.3 |
| `--show` | `SHOW` |  |  | try: hunks shown |
| `--lines` | `LINES` |  |  | exact: differing lines shown |
| `--count` | `COUNT` |  |  | neighbours: sources shown |

## asm-score

Score candidate code against target code with asm-differ/permuter penalties

```text
n64dk asm-score target candidate [--vram VRAM] [--ignore-stack]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` (positional) | `target` | yes |  | retail code bytes (raw, big-endian) |
| `candidate` (positional) | `candidate` | yes |  | relocated candidate code bytes |
| `--vram` | `VRAM` |  | `2147483648` |  |
| `--ignore-stack` |  |  |  | do not penalise stack offsets |

## assets-scan

Find compressed streams and loader-referenced ROM ranges; write an interval ledger

```text
n64dk assets-scan rom [--out OUT] [--extract] [--verify] [--deflate-align DEFLATE_ALIGN] [--no-lzari-brute]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rom` (positional) | `rom` | yes |  | ROM image (z64, v64 or n64 byte order) |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  |  | directory for ledger.tsv, assets_scan.json and extracted streams |
| `--extract` |  |  |  | write each decoded stream to OUT/streams/ |
| `--verify` |  |  |  | re-encode every stream and report identical/roundtrip |
| `--deflate-align` | `DEFLATE_ALIGN` |  | `` | try raw deflate at every N-byte boundary (0 = off) |
| `--no-lzari-brute` |  |  |  | only probe LZARI at loader-evidenced starts and stream chains |

## audio

Audio inventory: libaudio ctl/tbl, MIDI, libmus, seqfile banks; byte-exact intervals

```text
n64dk audio rom [--out OUT] [--wav] [--midi] [--rate RATE]
```

## blind-check

Verify that no forbidden source tree or donor is reachable from a blind run's configuration; write a digest-sealed isolation receipt (read-only)

```text
n64dk blind-check [--forbid FORBID] [--manifest MANIFEST] [--title TITLE] [--invocation INVOCATION] [--project PROJECT] [--donors DONORS] [--library LIBRARY] [--no-content] [--shared-library MANIFEST@sha256:HEX] [--out OUT]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--forbid` | `FORBID` |  |  | a tree the run must not reach (repeatable) |
| `--manifest` | `MANIFEST` |  |  | a corpus manifest: its blind-excluded entries are forbidden |
| `--title` | `TITLE` |  |  | only the manifest entries concerning this title |
| `--invocation` | `INVOCATION` |  |  | a run's solver/invocation.json (or any JSON of run options) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  |  | the project directory (its n64dk.toml is read) |
| `--donors` | `DONORS` |  |  | a donors file the run will use |
| `--library` | `LIBRARY` |  |  | a donor library directory the run will use |
| `--no-content` |  |  |  | skip the byte-for-byte copy check |
| `--shared-library` | `MANIFEST@sha256:HEX` |  |  | a n64dk.shared-library/1 manifest pinned by its SHA-256: copies of the files it lists (by digest) are exempt and listed in the receipt (opt-in, repeatable) |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  |  | write the receipt here |

## decompile-batch

Run decompile-init and decompile-run over a set of ROMs, one at a time, sharing every strictly exact function between them through a library

```text
n64dk decompile-batch rom [rom ...] --out OUT [--library LIBRARY] [--passes PASSES] [--donors DONORS] [--source-tree DIR] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--calibrate CALIBRATE] [--budget BUDGET] [--max-size MAX_SIZE] [--search-economics] [--workers WORKERS] [--refine-command REFINE_COMMAND] [--refine-jobs REFINE_JOBS] [--init-timeout INIT_TIMEOUT] [--force-init] [--effort {quick,normal,deep,exhaustive}] [--export] [--wait-for-lock] [--force-resources]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rom` (positional) | `rom [rom ...]` | yes |  | ROM images (read, never written), in the order to run them |
| `--out` | `OUT` | yes |  | directory for the projects, the runs, the library and the report |
| `--library` | `LIBRARY` |  |  | library directory to share with other batches (default: <out>/library) |
| `--passes` | `PASSES` |  | `2` | visits per title; a second visit gives early titles what later ones matched (default: 2) |
| `--donors` | `DONORS` |  |  | donors TOML used for every title in addition to the library |
| `--source-tree` | `DIR` |  |  | a C source tree that may belong to one of the titles (repeatable; any layout). After a title's first run every tree is measured against it; one that gives it functions becomes a donor of that title and the title runs again (see source-donor) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | toolchain root (default: N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |
| `--calibrate` | `CALIBRATE` |  | `96` | functions sampled per title to measure its recipe |
| `--budget` | `BUDGET` |  |  | maximum builds per function (default: the --effort mode's, or 100 without --effort) |
| `--max-size` | `MAX_SIZE` |  | `` | largest function attempted (0: no limit) |
| `--search-economics` |  |  |  | stop searching strata whose searches have returned nothing (see decompile-run) |
| `--workers` | `WORKERS` |  |  | worker processes of each run |
| `--refine-command` | `REFINE_COMMAND` |  |  | refiner asked about the cases each run leaves (see decompile-run) |
| `--refine-jobs` | `REFINE_JOBS` |  |  |  |
| `--init-timeout` | `INIT_TIMEOUT` |  | `1800` | seconds one title's survey may take before it is reported as failed (0: no limit) |
| `--force-init` |  |  |  | survey every ROM again even when its project exists |
| `--effort` | `{quick,normal,deep,exhaustive}` |  |  | decompile-run effort mode of every title (default: decompile-run's) |
| `--export` |  |  |  | after each title's run, write its export tree (<out>/<title>.export) and status |
| `--wait-for-lock` |  |  |  | wait for another heavy n64dk job to finish instead of refusing to start |
| `--force-resources` |  |  |  | start even when memory, memory pressure or disk space are below the thresholds |

| `--source-tree` | `DIR` |  |  | a C source tree that may belong to one of the titles (repeatable; any layout). After a title's first run every tree is measured against it; one that gives it functions becomes a donor of that title and the title runs again (see source-donor) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | toolchain root (default: N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |
| `--calibrate` | `CALIBRATE` |  | `96` | functions sampled per title to measure its recipe |
| `--budget` | `BUDGET` |  |  | maximum builds per function (default: the --effort mode's, or 100 without --effort) |
| `--max-size` | `MAX_SIZE` |  | `` | largest function attempted (0: no limit) |
| `--search-economics` |  |  |  | stop searching strata whose searches have returned nothing (see decompile-run) |
| `--workers` | `WORKERS` |  |  | worker processes of each run |
| `--refine-command` | `REFINE_COMMAND` |  |  | refiner asked about the cases each run leaves (see decompile-run) |
| `--refine-jobs` | `REFINE_JOBS` |  |  |  |
| `--init-timeout` | `INIT_TIMEOUT` |  | `1800` | seconds one title's survey may take before it is reported as failed (0: no limit) |
| `--force-init` |  |  |  | survey every ROM again even when its project exists |
| `--effort` | `{quick,normal,deep,exhaustive}` |  |  | decompile-run effort mode of every title (default: decompile-run's) |
| `--export` |  |  |  | after each title's run, write its export tree (<out>/<title>.export) and status |
| `--wait-for-lock` |  |  |  | wait for another heavy n64dk job to finish instead of refusing to start |
| `--force-resources` |  |  |  | start even when memory, memory pressure or disk space are below the thresholds |

## decompile-export

Write a finished decompile-run as a tree ready to commit: one source per matched function, the function table, recipes and symbols (nothing of the ROM)

```text
n64dk decompile-export --project PROJECT --run RUN --out OUT [--title TITLE] [--no-cover] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `PROJECT` | yes |  | the project the run was made on |
| `--run` | `RUN` | yes |  | the run's output directory (holds state/, queue/, report.json) |
| `--out` | `OUT` | yes |  | directory to write (created; existing files are overwritten) |
| `--title` | `TITLE` |  |  | title for the README (default: the ROM's header name) |
| `--no-cover` |  |  |  | do not write assembly for the functions that are not decompiled |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | toolchain root, for the assembler (default: N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |

## decompile-init

Build a decompile-run project from a ROM alone: survey, catalogue, symbols, starting recipe

```text
n64dk decompile-init rom --out OUT [--image {auto,static,emulated}] [--calibrate CALIBRATE] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--no-lzari-brute] [--refine-command REFINE_COMMAND] [--no-compressed] [--no-region-scan] [--force]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rom` (positional) | `rom` | yes |  | ROM image (z64, v64 or n64 byte order); it is read, never written |
| `--out` | `OUT` | yes |  | project directory to create |
| `--image` | `{auto,static,emulated}` |  | `'auto'` | program image: emulate the boot only when a loader runs (auto), never, or always |
| `--calibrate` | `CALIBRATE` |  | `96` | functions decompile-run samples to measure the title's recipe (0: none) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | toolchain root to record in the project (default: N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |
| `--no-lzari-brute` |  |  |  | probe LZARI only at loader-evidenced starts |
| `--refine-command` | `REFINE_COMMAND` |  |  | record a refiner in the project ([run.refine] command): decompile-run then asks it about every case the mechanical pass leaves. It receives disassembly and candidate sources |
| `--no-compressed` |  |  |  | do not look for code inside compressed streams (zlib, gzip, deflate, MIO0, Yay0, Yaz0) |
| `--no-region-scan` |  |  |  | do not scan the whole ROM for code that no loader range points at |
| `--force` |  |  |  | rebuild an existing project |

## decompile-project

Turn a decompile-export tree (plus link-layout output) into a maintainable project tree with a Makefile, recipes, receipts and per-unit status (no ROM bytes; no credit)

```text
n64dk decompile-project source --out OUT [--link-layout DIR] [--project PROJECT] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--no-toolchain-lock] [--force] [--limit LIMIT]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` (positional) | `source` | yes |  | a decompile-export tree (or a run directory holding one in export/) |
| `--out` | `OUT` | yes |  | project directory to create, or a generated project to update |
| `--link-layout` | `DIR` |  |  | `n64dk link-layout --out` directory (link.ld, objects.tsv) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  |  | the decompile-init project of the ROM: read only, for the raw units' digests and to keep the output apart from it and its ROM |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | toolchain root for the lock file (default: N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |
| `--no-toolchain-lock` |  |  |  | do not hash the toolchain |
| `--force` |  |  |  | overwrite or remove files changed by hand since generation |
| `--limit` | `LIMIT` |  | `50` | paths listed per category in the report |

## decompile-receipt

Exhaustive-treatment receipt of a finished decompile-run: what ran, what is left and which contract clauses its own records satisfy (read-only)

```text
n64dk decompile-receipt run [--out OUT] [--require]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run` (positional) | `run` | yes |  | the --out directory of a finished decompile-run |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  |  | write receipt.json and receipt.md here |
| `--require` |  |  |  | exit 4 when a contract clause is not satisfied |

## decompile-run

Drive every configured image through boundaries, donors, resolution, strict queue and ledger

```text
n64dk decompile-run [--project PROJECT] [--image IMAGE] [--all-images] [--out OUT] [--effort {deep,exhaustive,normal,quick}] [--rounds ROUNDS] [--schedule {observe,order}] [--budget-time BUDGET_TIME] [--budget-builds BUDGET_BUILDS] [--budget-model-calls BUDGET_MODEL_CALLS] [--resume RUN_DIR] [--declare-assumed] [--allow-project-output] [--donors DONORS] [--blind-forbid TREE] [--blind-walk-limit N] [--blind-shared-library MANIFEST@sha256:HEX] [--mode {blind,research,source-tree}] [--corpus-manifest FILE] [--title NAME] [--donor-index DONOR_INDEX] [--library LIBRARY] [--donor DONOR] [--exclude-donor EXCLUDE_DONOR] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--pipeline PIPELINE] [--flags FLAGS] [--jobs JOBS] [--calibrate CALIBRATE] [--refine-command REFINE_COMMAND] [--refine-rounds REFINE_ROUNDS] [--refine-max-cases REFINE_MAX_CASES] [--refine-max-score REFINE_MAX_SCORE] [--refine-jobs REFINE_JOBS] [--refine-known-source DIR] [--workers WORKERS] [--worker-memory-mb WORKER_MEMORY_MB] [--memory-reserve-mb MEMORY_RESERVE_MB] [--budget BUDGET] [--search-ceiling SEARCH_CEILING] [--limit LIMIT] [--order ORDER] [--regional-calibration] [--no-regional-calibration] [--region-recipes] [--unit-recipes] [--skip-unknown-search] [--recipe-gate] [--no-recipe-gate] [--search-economics] [--only-names ONLY_NAMES] [--max-size MAX_SIZE] [--min-confidence MIN_CONFIDENCE] [--strict-only] [--skip-stage STAGE] [--discovery {repair,audit,off}] [--small-data {auto,off}] [--data-stage {off,report,replay}] [--redo] [--receipts] [--wait-for-lock] [--force-resources]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  |  | project directory (required unless --resume) |
| `--image` | `IMAGE` |  |  | logical image name (repeatable) |
| `--all-images` |  |  |  |  |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  |  | output directory for state, queue, reports (not a source tree; required unless --resume) |
| `--effort` | `{deep,exhaustive,normal,quick}` |  |  | effort mode (default normal: exactly the single pass decompile-run always made); deep and exhaustive add later rounds until a fixed point; see docs/solver.md |
| `--rounds` | `ROUNDS` |  |  | most rounds (default: the effort mode's) |
| `--schedule` | `{observe,order}` |  |  | observe: record the ranking's predictions only; order: let it order later rounds' work (default: the effort mode's; never changes what is credited) |
| `--budget-time` | `BUDGET_TIME` |  |  | stop starting work after this long: seconds, or 30m, 2h |
| `--budget-builds` | `BUDGET_BUILDS` |  |  | stop starting work after this many builds (all images) |
| `--budget-model-calls` | `BUDGET_MODEL_CALLS` |  |  | stop asking the refiner after this many calls |
| `--resume` | `RUN_DIR` |  |  | continue a run from its case store and rounds.jsonl (finished rounds are not redone) |
| `--declare-assumed` |  |  |  | declare self-describing data addresses (D_<address>) that byte-identical cases lean on and verify those cases again (default: [run] declare_assumed) |
| `--allow-project-output` |  |  |  | allow --out in the project outside .n64dk (unsafe for generated state) |
| `--donors` | `DONORS` |  |  | donors TOML for transplant (see docs/donors.example.toml) |
| `--blind-forbid` | `TREE` |  |  | enforce a blind run: refuse (exit 3) before any stage when TREE (a source tree that must not inform the run; repeatable) is reachable from the run's configuration, project or environment, and check again at the end; receipts in solver/blind_*.json |
| `--blind-walk-limit` | `N` |  |  | entries a blind run's isolation check walks per configured directory and indexes per forbidden tree (default 50000); a blind run whose check would stop short is refused |
| `--blind-shared-library` | `MANIFEST@sha256:HEX` |  |  | with --blind-forbid: a pinned shared public library (shared-library-pin) whose content copies inside a forbidden tree do not count as reaching it (repeatable) |
| `--mode` | `{blind,research,source-tree}` |  |  | what the run may learn from, enforced (default: no mode, unchecked as before). blind: the ROM, the kit and other titles' donors; the corpus manifest's trees of this title are forbidden (strict --blind-forbid), a donor that is this title or another revision of it is refused, and the project's symbol files and catalogues may hold no name those trees define. research: public general knowledge (SDK, other titles' trees, research notes), never this title's source tree. source-tree: the title's own tree is allowed and recorded. Saved with the invocation, recorded in report.json, solver/run_mode.json and the run directory's provenance; a directory filled under a less strict mode is refused (exit 3) |
| `--corpus-manifest` | `FILE` |  |  | with --mode: a n64dk.corpus/1 manifest whose entries concerning this title (by --title, the ROM header's name or game code, or its SHA-1) are forbidden (blind, research) or recorded (source-tree) |
| `--title` | `NAME` |  |  | with --mode: the title's name as the corpus manifest and donors spell it (repeatable; the ROM header's internal name is always used too) |
| `--donor-index` | `DONOR_INDEX` |  |  | donor index file (default: <out>/donor_index.json) |
| `--library` | `LIBRARY` |  |  | directory of finished runs: every other title registered there is used as a donor, and this run registers its own strictly exact functions when it ends |
| `--donor` | `DONOR` |  |  | use only these donors |
| `--exclude-donor` | `EXCLUDE_DONOR` |  |  | leave these donors out (always exclude the target project itself) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  |  |
| `--pipeline` | `PIPELINE` |  | `'kmc+builtin'` | default pipeline when [run] does not set one |
| `--flags` | `FLAGS` |  | `'-O2 -G0 -mips3 -mgp32 -mfp32'` |  |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  | `` | parallel builds in total (default: adaptive, capped at 4; set N64DK_ALLOW_OVERSUBSCRIBE=1 for an explicit unsafe override) |
| `--calibrate` | `CALIBRATE` |  |  | functions sampled to measure the title's recipe before the sweep (default: [run] calibrate, else none) |
| `--refine-command` | `REFINE_COMMAND` |  |  | external author for unresolved cases: reads a prompt on stdin, prints C (default: [run.refine] command; none configured means the stage is skipped) |
| `--refine-rounds` | `REFINE_ROUNDS` |  |  |  |
| `--refine-max-cases` | `REFINE_MAX_CASES` |  |  |  |
| `--refine-max-score` | `REFINE_MAX_SCORE` |  |  |  |
| `--refine-jobs` | `REFINE_JOBS` |  |  | refiner calls at once (default 1) |
| `--refine-known-source` | `DIR` |  |  | folder of known source (an imported tree's split/): prompts holding its lines are not sent, and answers reproducing it are flagged as recollection; repeatable |
| `--workers` | `WORKERS` |  | `` | worker processes for the resolve stage (default 0: automatic, from hardware threads and free memory) |
| `--worker-memory-mb` | `WORKER_MEMORY_MB` |  | `` | memory estimate used by automatic worker selection (0: adaptive) |
| `--memory-reserve-mb` | `MEMORY_RESERVE_MB` |  | `` | memory excluded from automatic workers (0: adaptive) |
| `--budget` | `BUDGET` |  |  | maximum builds per function (default: the effort mode's; normal 200) |
| `--search-ceiling` | `SEARCH_CEILING` |  |  | skip the variant search when the best draft scores above this (default: [run] search_ceiling, else the resolver's measured default; 0: always search) |
| `--limit` | `LIMIT` |  | `` | at most this many functions per image (smallest first) |
| `--order` | `ORDER` |  |  | attempt order within a pass: size (default), reverse, shuffle:SEED; for determinism checks |
| `--regional-calibration` |  |  |  | calibrate each toolchain region (n64dk.match.toolchain_regions) on its own functions and start every function from its region's recipe (default: [run] regional_calibration, else the effort mode's: on in exhaustive only) |
| `--no-regional-calibration` |  |  |  | never calibrate by region, whatever [run] or the effort mode say |
| `--region-recipes` |  |  |  | enable the experimental region-recipe retry (measured 3/126; off by default) |
| `--unit-recipes` |  |  |  | enable the experimental nearest-unit recipe retry (measured 0/165; off by default) |
| `--skip-unknown-search` |  |  |  | experimental: skip variant search in unknown-toolchain regions; advisory only by default |
| `--recipe-gate` |  |  |  | run the wide recipe retry only for functions with unoptimised-code evidence (in the function or its neighbourhood) or another compiler family (default; [run] recipe_gate). Measured offline: 0 exact lost on 3 held-out blind titles, 67K builds saved |
| `--no-recipe-gate` |  |  |  | run the wide recipe retry on every far function (round-10 behaviour) |
| `--search-economics` |  |  |  | stop the variant search in a stratum (recipe x first-draft distance) whose searches have returned nothing after a fixed spend, probing it now and then (n64dk.match.economics) |
| `--only-names` | `ONLY_NAMES` |  |  | attempt only these functions: comma-separated names or @FILE (one per line); repeatable |
| `--max-size` | `MAX_SIZE` |  |  | attempt only functions up to this size (default: the effort mode's; 0: no limit) |
| `--min-confidence` | `MIN_CONFIDENCE` |  | `0.8` |  |
| `--strict-only` |  |  |  | queue only strictly exact cases |
| `--skip-stage` | `STAGE` |  |  | skip a stage or switch one subsystem off for an ablation run (repeatable): discovery, boundaries, donors, calibrate, resolve, ledger, declare, context, draft, draft-portfolio, draft-forms, redraft, recipes, cross-recipes, search, hand-forms, frame-fit, twin, handasm, at-loads, rodata-settlement, round-search, round-recipe-sweep, round-draft-options, round-refine, refine, cascade-neighbours. `calibrate` also stops recipe-doubt calibration, which --calibrate 0 does not. The ablation switches (from `declare` on) are also read as N64DK_DISABLE_<NAME>=1; what a run switched off is in report.json `ablation` |
| `--discovery` | `{repair,audit,off}` |  |  | discovery gate before every stage (default repair): audit each catalogue against call, pointer and prologue evidence; repair adds evidence-backed functions to an incomplete catalogue in the run directory (never the project); audit only reports |
| `--small-data` | `{auto,off}` |  |  | auto (default): recover the program's _gp from the code that sets $gp and offer the small-data (-G) assembler lanes to functions that address through $gp; off: neither |
| `--data-stage` | `{off,report,replay}` |  |  | data stage after resolution (default off). report: group every data reference that keeps a case or donor unit waiting by symbol, section and image, and place it only from evidence independent of that unit (OUT/IMAGE/data_ownership.json, data_replay.json); replay: also re-verify strictly the waiting cases whose every data placement is established |
| `--redo` |  |  |  | recompute checkpointed stages |
| `--receipts` |  |  |  | write a proof receipt for every settled result into OUT/receipts when the run ends (rebuilds each once; see issue-receipts, verify-run) |
| `--wait-for-lock` |  |  |  | wait for another heavy n64dk job to finish instead of refusing to start |
| `--force-resources` |  |  |  | start even when memory, memory pressure or disk space are below the thresholds |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run_dir` (positional) | `run_dir` | yes |  | the --out directory of a decompile-run |
| `--image` | `IMAGE` |  |  | only this image |
| `--show` | `SHOW` |  | `5` | example functions per cause |

## discovery-audit

Check a project's function catalogues against call, pointer, prologue and datamap evidence; incomplete catalogues fail the gate (read-only)

```text
n64dk discovery-audit --project PROJECT [--image IMAGE] [--out OUT] [--repair] [--no-fail] [--overlays] [--indirect]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `PROJECT` | yes |  | project directory (read only) |
| `--image` | `IMAGE` |  |  | only this image (repeatable) |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  |  | write discovery_audit.json (and what --repair makes) here |
| `--repair` |  |  |  | place code the title calls but no image holds, and add evidence-backed functions to incomplete catalogues; writes under --out, never into the project |
| `--no-fail` |  |  |  | exit 0 even when a catalogue is incomplete |
| `--overlays` |  |  |  | also infer per-overlay bases inside each image (a segment holding several separately linked overlays); a report only, never applied to a catalogue |
| `--indirect` |  |  |  | also resolve jr/jalr targets (switch tables, pointer tables, stored pointers) and non-returning functions (n64dk.analysis.indirect); a report only, never applied to a catalogue |

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `--profile` | `{matching,gpu-research,full}` |  | `'matching'` |  |
| `--fix-user` |  |  |  | print user-local remediation commands; never mutates the host |
| `--skip-functional` |  |  |  | skip functional smoke tests |
| `--host` |  |  |  | check this machine only (no project): dependencies, optional capabilities, compilers, host, disk, memory, output path, stored schemas; exit 1 on a required failure |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  |  | with --host: an output directory to vet |
| `--run` | `RUN` |  |  | with --host: a run directory whose stored formats to check |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | with --host: toolchain root (default: N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |

## draft-sweep

Draft unmatched functions with m2c, build them, compare them and rank the results

```text
n64dk draft-sweep [--rom ROM] [--project PROJECT] [--config CONFIG] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--symbols SYMBOLS] [--include INCLUDE] [--normalizer NORMALIZER] [--vram-delta VRAM_DELTA] [--image-name IMAGE_NAME] [--jobs JOBS] --catalogue CATALOGUE [--catalogue-shift CATALOGUE_SHIFT] [--manifest MANIFEST] [--pipeline PIPELINE] [--flags FLAGS] [--context CONTEXT] [--no-preflight] --out OUT [--limit LIMIT] [--max-size MAX_SIZE] [--show SHOW]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rom` | `ROM` |  |  | physical retail/composite image (may be omitted when --image-name selects a configured [images] entry) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  |  | project directory: working directory for builds, default include/, .toolchain/ and symbol files (default: current directory) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  |  | n64dk.toml (default: <project>/n64dk.toml) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | directory holding kmc-gcc-2.7.2/, ido5.3/, ... |
| `--symbols` | `SYMBOLS` |  |  | symbol file: splat symbol_addrs.txt or catalogue TOML (repeatable) |
| `-I`, `--include` | `INCLUDE` |  |  | include directory (repeatable) |
| `--normalizer` | `NORMALIZER` |  |  | assembly normalizer hook, e.g. 'python3 tools/norm.py {input} {output}' |
| `--vram-delta` | `VRAM_DELTA` |  |  | VRAM - ROM offset of the code segment |
| `--image-name` | `IMAGE_NAME` |  |  | logical image identity for overlapping overlay address spaces |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  |  | parallel builds (default: CPU count) |
| `--catalogue` | `CATALOGUE` | yes |  | function catalogue TOML or symbol_addrs.txt |
| `--catalogue-shift` | `CATALOGUE_SHIFT` |  | `` | subtract catalogue VRAM minus linked VRAM |
| `--manifest` | `MANIFEST` |  |  | ROM_START/SIZE/SOURCE manifest of already matched code (repeatable) |
| `--pipeline` | `PIPELINE` |  | `'kmc+builtin'` |  |
| `--flags` | `FLAGS` |  | `'-O2 -G0 -mips3 -mgp32 -mfp32'` |  |
| `--context` | `CONTEXT` |  |  | preprocessed C context for m2c (types and prototypes) |
| `--no-preflight` |  |  |  | allow catalogue entries that fail project inventory/boundary validation |
| `--out` | `OUT` | yes |  | output directory for drafts and report.json |
| `--limit` | `LIMIT` |  | `` |  |
| `--max-size` | `MAX_SIZE` |  | `4096` |  |
| `--show` | `SHOW` |  | `20` |  |

## entry-audit

Classify every catalogued range: complete function, fragment, false split, non-standard ABI, hand-written, embedded data; with compiler family and NOP roles

```text
n64dk entry-audit image [--vram-delta VRAM_DELTA] --catalogue CATALOGUE [--catalogue-shift CATALOGUE_SHIFT] [--show SHOW] [--function NAME_OR_ADDRESS] [--all]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` (positional) | `image` | yes |  | ROM or linear image |

| `source` (positional) | `source` | yes |  | C (or assembly) source file |
| `--rom` | `ROM` |  |  | physical retail/composite image (may be omitted when --image-name selects a configured [images] entry) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  |  | project directory: working directory for builds, default include/, .toolchain/ and symbol files (default: current directory) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  |  | n64dk.toml (default: <project>/n64dk.toml) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | directory holding kmc-gcc-2.7.2/, ido5.3/, ... |
| `--symbols` | `SYMBOLS` |  |  | symbol file: splat symbol_addrs.txt or catalogue TOML (repeatable) |
| `-I`, `--include` | `INCLUDE` |  |  | include directory (repeatable) |
| `--normalizer` | `NORMALIZER` |  |  | assembly normalizer hook, e.g. 'python3 tools/norm.py {input} {output}' |
| `--vram-delta` | `VRAM_DELTA` |  |  | VRAM - ROM offset of the code segment |
| `--image-name` | `IMAGE_NAME` |  |  | logical image identity for overlapping overlay address spaces |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  |  | parallel builds (default: CPU count) |
| `--addr` | `ADDR` |  |  | VRAM of the unit's .text (hex; default: search the ROM for the compiled code) |
| `--size` | `SIZE` |  |  | text size in bytes (hex; default: compiled size) |
| `--pipeline` | `{kmc+hook,kmc+builtin,kmc+as,kmc+asn64,kmc+atload,kmc+atmacro,kmc+asg,kmc+gas,ido5.3,ido7.1,sn,as,gnu-as}` |  |  | build pipeline (default: first available) |
| `--flags` | `FLAGS` |  |  | compiler flags (default: the toolchain profile's standard flags) |
| `--sweep` |  |  |  | search pipelines x flags x rodata placement for the first exact configuration |
| `--pipelines` | `PIPELINES` |  |  | comma-separated pipelines for --sweep (default: all available) |
| `--all` |  |  |  | with --sweep: do not stop at the first exact result |
| `--extended-flags` |  |  |  | with --sweep: add bounded GCC CPU and optimization-pass discriminators |
| `--no-infer` |  |  |  | do not recover unresolved external symbols from the retail code |
| `--lines` | `LINES` |  | `24` | diff lines shown in text output |

## match-batch

Rebuild and verify every unit of one or more matching manifests in parallel

```text
n64dk match-batch MANIFEST[=PIPELINE] [MANIFEST[=PIPELINE] ...] [--rom ROM] [--project PROJECT] [--config CONFIG] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--symbols SYMBOLS] [--include INCLUDE] [--normalizer NORMALIZER] [--vram-delta VRAM_DELTA] [--image-name IMAGE_NAME] [--jobs JOBS] [--kmc-lane {hook,builtin,as,asn64}] [--source-template SOURCE_TEMPLATE] [--flags FLAGS] [--status-flags STATUS=FLAGS] [--rodata-map RODATA_MAP] [--infer-externals] [--only ONLY]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `manifests` (positional) | `MANIFEST[=PIPELINE] [MANIFEST[=PIPELINE] ...]` | yes |  | manifest TSV; optional =PIPELINE overrides the pipeline taken from its header |
| `--rom` | `ROM` |  |  | physical retail/composite image (may be omitted when --image-name selects a configured [images] entry) (otherwise defaults to n64dk.toml [match] rom or baserom*.z64) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  |  | project directory: working directory for builds, default include/, .toolchain/ and symbol files (default: current directory) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  |  | n64dk.toml (default: <project>/n64dk.toml) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | directory holding kmc-gcc-2.7.2/, ido5.3/, ... |
| `--symbols` | `SYMBOLS` |  |  | symbol file: splat symbol_addrs.txt or catalogue TOML (repeatable) |
| `-I`, `--include` | `INCLUDE` |  |  | include directory (repeatable) |
| `--normalizer` | `NORMALIZER` |  |  | assembly normalizer hook, e.g. 'python3 tools/norm.py {input} {output}' |
| `--vram-delta` | `VRAM_DELTA` |  |  | VRAM - ROM offset of the code segment |
| `--image-name` | `IMAGE_NAME` |  |  | logical image identity for overlapping overlay address spaces |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  |  | parallel builds (default: CPU count) |
| `--kmc-lane` | `{hook,builtin,as,asn64}` |  |  | assembler lane for KMC rows without --assembler= (default: hook when a normalizer is configured, else builtin) |
| `--source-template` | `SOURCE_TEMPLATE` |  |  | unit-row source path, e.g. 'src/code/{unit}.c' |
| `--flags` | `FLAGS` |  |  | compiler flags for unit rows (default: toolchain profile) |
| `--status-flags` | `STATUS=FLAGS` |  |  | extra compiler flags for unit rows with this status (repeatable) |
| `--rodata-map` | `RODATA_MAP` |  |  | TSV UNIT VRAM SIZE fixing .rodata placement of unit rows |
| `--infer-externals` |  |  |  | recover symbols no symbol file or batch unit defines from the retail code |
| `--only` | `ONLY` |  |  | verify only units whose name contains this |

| `--summary-only` |  |  |  | omit candidate collections |
| `--best-only` |  |  |  | return only the best candidate |
| `--best-details` |  |  |  | return only the best candidate with its outcome |

## relink-image

Link every unit of one image of a decompile-project tree at its own address, raw blobs cut from your ROM for the rest, and compare the image byte for byte (opt-in; ROM bytes only under --build; no credit)

```text
n64dk relink-image source --project PROJECT [--image IMAGE] --build BUILD [--extent VRAM_START:VRAM_END] [--assumed {raw,link}] [--linker {gnu-ld,kit}] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--any-rom] [--keep-image] [--limit LIMIT]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source` (positional) | `source` | yes |  | a decompile-project tree (read only) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` | yes |  | the decompile-init project of your ROM (read only): the ROM, the image files, the toolchains |
| `--image` | `IMAGE` |  | `'main'` | the image to relink (default: main) |
| `--build` | `BUILD` | yes |  | build directory: objects, raw blobs cut from your ROM, link.ld, the linked image and RELINK.json; never inside the project tree, the kit or a git work tree |
| `--extent` | `VRAM_START:VRAM_END` |  |  | hex VRAM range to compare (default: config/layout.json for main, the whole image file otherwise) |
| `--assumed` | `{raw,link}` |  | `'raw'` | assumed units (addresses read from the target): raw blobs (default) or linked (then no level is claimed) |
| `--linker` | `{gnu-ld,kit}` |  | `'gnu-ld'` | gnu-ld: mips-linux-gnu-ld on the generated script (default); kit: the kit's own relocator (a cross-check) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | toolchain root (default: the project's configuration, N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |
| `--any-rom` |  |  |  | do not require the ROM SHA-1 the project records |
| `--keep-image` |  |  |  | keep the linked image (relinked.elf, relinked.bin) in --build; it holds the raw blobs, so by default only raw/raw.o, the extraction input, keeps ROM bytes |
| `--limit` | `LIMIT` |  | `50` | items listed per category in the report |

## resolve-case

Diagnose one unmatched function and climb the resolution ladder (draft, iterate, classify)

```text
n64dk resolve-case [--rom ROM] [--project PROJECT] [--config CONFIG] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--symbols SYMBOLS] [--include INCLUDE] [--normalizer NORMALIZER] [--vram-delta VRAM_DELTA] [--image-name IMAGE_NAME] [--jobs JOBS] [source] --addr ADDR --size SIZE [--name NAME] [--pipeline PIPELINE] [--flags FLAGS] [--context CONTEXT] [--context-parts CONTEXT_PARTS] [--proto-confidence PROTO_CONFIDENCE] [--catalogue CATALOGUE] [--budget BUDGET] [--search-ceiling SEARCH_CEILING] [--state STATE] [--events EVENTS] [--no-draft] [--draft-portfolio] [--draft-options DRAFT_OPTIONS] [--no-recipes] [--force] [--out OUT]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rom` | `ROM` |  |  | physical retail/composite image (may be omitted when --image-name selects a configured [images] entry) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  |  | project directory: working directory for builds, default include/, .toolchain/ and symbol files (default: current directory) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  |  | n64dk.toml (default: <project>/n64dk.toml) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | directory holding kmc-gcc-2.7.2/, ido5.3/, ... |
| `--symbols` | `SYMBOLS` |  |  | symbol file: splat symbol_addrs.txt or catalogue TOML (repeatable) |
| `-I`, `--include` | `INCLUDE` |  |  | include directory (repeatable) |
| `--normalizer` | `NORMALIZER` |  |  | assembly normalizer hook, e.g. 'python3 tools/norm.py {input} {output}' |
| `--vram-delta` | `VRAM_DELTA` |  |  | VRAM - ROM offset of the code segment |
| `--image-name` | `IMAGE_NAME` |  |  | logical image identity for overlapping overlay address spaces |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  |  | parallel builds (default: CPU count) |
| `source` (positional) | `[source]` |  |  | existing candidate C file (omit to start from an m2c draft) |
| `--addr` | `ADDR` | yes |  |  |
| `--size` | `SIZE` | yes |  |  |
| `--name` | `NAME` |  |  |  |
| `--pipeline` | `PIPELINE` |  | `'kmc+builtin'` |  |
| `--flags` | `FLAGS` |  | `'-O2 -G0 -mips3 -mgp32 -mfp32'` |  |
| `--context` | `CONTEXT` |  |  | m2c context file, or `auto` to recover structs, globals and prototypes from the image (needs --catalogue) |
| `--context-parts` | `CONTEXT_PARTS` |  | `'structs,globals,prototypes'` |  |
| `--proto-confidence` | `PROTO_CONFIDENCE` |  | `0.9` |  |
| `--catalogue` | `CATALOGUE` |  |  | function catalogue: neighbouring starts for boundary evidence |
| `--budget` | `BUDGET` |  | `300` | maximum builds per function |
| `--search-ceiling` | `SEARCH_CEILING` |  | `40` | skip the variant search when the best draft scores above this (0: always search) |
| `--state` | `STATE` |  |  | case store directory (default: <project>/.n64dk/resolve) |
| `--events` | `EVENTS` |  |  | append JSON-lines progress events to this file |
| `--no-draft` |  |  |  | never generate an m2c draft |
| `--draft-portfolio` |  |  |  | build several drafts (plain, with context, alternative m2c renderings) and continue from the closest |
| `--draft-options` | `DRAFT_OPTIONS` |  | `''` | comma-separated extra m2c renderings for the portfolio, e.g. --no-andor,--gotos-only |
| `--no-recipes` |  |  |  | never try alternative compiler recipes |
| `--force` |  |  |  | continue past boundary/ABI findings and redo exact cases |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  |  | write the best candidate here |

## resolve-export

Write exact resolution cases as an integration queue (sources, manifest rows, assumptions)

```text
n64dk resolve-export --state STATE --out OUT [--image-name IMAGE_NAME] [--strict-only]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--state` | `STATE` | yes |  | case store directory |
| `--out` | `OUT` | yes |  | output directory (never inside a project source tree) |
| `--image-name` | `IMAGE_NAME` |  |  |  |
| `--strict-only` |  |  |  | leave out cases that still rest on assumptions |

## resolve-hard

Run the resolution ladder over every function without matching source and report the queue

```text
n64dk resolve-hard [--rom ROM] [--project PROJECT] [--config CONFIG] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--symbols SYMBOLS] [--include INCLUDE] [--normalizer NORMALIZER] [--vram-delta VRAM_DELTA] [--image-name IMAGE_NAME] [--jobs JOBS] --catalogue CATALOGUE [--catalogue-shift CATALOGUE_SHIFT] [--manifest FILE[=PIPELINE]] [--region-recipes] [--unit-recipes] [--skip-unknown-search] [--search-economics] [--only-names ONLY_NAMES] [--limit LIMIT] [--order ORDER] [--max-size MAX_SIZE] [--min-size MIN_SIZE] [--every EVERY] [--cross-recipes CROSS_RECIPES] [--keep-padding] [--refine-command REFINE_COMMAND] [--refine-rounds REFINE_ROUNDS] [--refine-names REFINE_NAMES] [--refine-max-cases REFINE_MAX_CASES] [--refine-max-score REFINE_MAX_SCORE] [--refine-jobs REFINE_JOBS] [--workers WORKERS] [--worker-memory-mb WORKER_MEMORY_MB] [--memory-reserve-mb MEMORY_RESERVE_MB] [--holdout HOLDOUT] [--show SHOW] [--pipeline PIPELINE] [--flags FLAGS] [--context CONTEXT] [--context-parts CONTEXT_PARTS] [--proto-confidence PROTO_CONFIDENCE] [--budget BUDGET] [--search-ceiling SEARCH_CEILING] [--state STATE] [--events EVENTS] [--no-draft] [--no-recipes] [--draft-portfolio] [--draft-options DRAFT_OPTIONS] [--force]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rom` | `ROM` |  |  | physical retail/composite image (may be omitted when --image-name selects a configured [images] entry) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` |  |  | project directory: working directory for builds, default include/, .toolchain/ and symbol files (default: current directory) |
| `--config` | `CONFIG` |  |  | n64dk.toml (default: <project>/n64dk.toml) |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | directory holding kmc-gcc-2.7.2/, ido5.3/, ... |
| `--symbols` | `SYMBOLS` |  |  | symbol file: splat symbol_addrs.txt or catalogue TOML (repeatable) |
| `-I`, `--include` | `INCLUDE` |  |  | include directory (repeatable) |
| `--normalizer` | `NORMALIZER` |  |  | assembly normalizer hook, e.g. 'python3 tools/norm.py {input} {output}' |
| `--vram-delta` | `VRAM_DELTA` |  |  | VRAM - ROM offset of the code segment |
| `--image-name` | `IMAGE_NAME` |  |  | logical image identity for overlapping overlay address spaces |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  |  | parallel builds (default: CPU count) |
| `--catalogue` | `CATALOGUE` | yes |  |  |
| `--catalogue-shift` | `CATALOGUE_SHIFT` |  | `` |  |
| `--manifest` | `FILE[=PIPELINE]` |  |  | manifest of already matched code (repeatable); with =PIPELINE its rows also teach the per-unit recipe map |
| `--region-recipes` |  |  |  | experimental: segment the image into recipe regions and retry under each region's recipe (measured 3/126; off by default) |
| `--unit-recipes` |  |  |  | experimental: retry from a nearby unit's recipe (measured 0/165; off by default) |
| `--skip-unknown-search` |  |  |  | experimental: suppress variant search in regions classified as an unknown toolchain; classification remains advisory by default |
| `--search-economics` |  |  |  | stop the variant search in strata whose searches have returned nothing (n64dk.match.economics) |
| `--only-names` | `ONLY_NAMES` |  |  | attempt only these functions: comma-separated names or @FILE (one per line); repeatable |
| `--limit` | `LIMIT` |  | `` |  |
| `--order` | `ORDER` |  |  | attempt order: size (default), reverse, shuffle:SEED (determinism checks; outcomes must not depend on it) |
| `--max-size` | `MAX_SIZE` |  | `` |  |
| `--min-size` | `MIN_SIZE` |  | `4` |  |
| `--every` | `EVERY` |  | `1` | take every Nth function (sampling for benchmarks) |
| `--cross-recipes` | `CROSS_RECIPES` |  |  | alternative recipes tried on the best drafts when none is exact (default: 8; a calibration sample uses many more) |
| `--keep-padding` |  |  |  | resolve catalogue intervals as given, including trailing alignment padding |
| `--refine-command` | `REFINE_COMMAND` |  |  | external author for the cases the ladder leaves unresolved: a command that reads a prompt on stdin and prints C (see n64dk.match.refine); every answer is built and strictly verified |
| `--refine-rounds` | `REFINE_ROUNDS` |  |  | rounds of feedback per function (default 3) |
| `--refine-names` | `REFINE_NAMES` |  |  | ask only about these functions (comma separated, repeatable) |
| `--refine-max-cases` | `REFINE_MAX_CASES` |  |  | ask about at most this many cases, nearest first |
| `--refine-max-score` | `REFINE_MAX_SCORE` |  |  | ask only about cases at most this far from the target |
| `--refine-jobs` | `REFINE_JOBS` |  |  | refiner calls in parallel (default 1) |
| `--workers` | `WORKERS` |  | `1` | worker processes sharing the sweep (0: automatic, from hardware threads and free memory); --jobs is divided among them |
| `--worker-memory-mb` | `WORKER_MEMORY_MB` |  | `` | automatic-worker memory estimate (0: derive from currently available memory) |
| `--memory-reserve-mb` | `MEMORY_RESERVE_MB` |  | `` | memory held outside workers (0: one eighth of currently available memory) |
| `--holdout` | `HOLDOUT` |  | `` | benchmark: treat every Nth catalogued function as unmatched even when a manifest covers it, withholding its own row from the recipe map |
| `--show` | `SHOW` |  | `3` |  |
| `--pipeline` | `PIPELINE` |  | `'kmc+builtin'` |  |
| `--flags` | `FLAGS` |  | `'-O2 -G0 -mips3 -mgp32 -mfp32'` |  |
| `--context` | `CONTEXT` |  |  | m2c context file, or `auto` |
| `--context-parts` | `CONTEXT_PARTS` |  | `'structs,globals,prototypes'` |  |
| `--proto-confidence` | `PROTO_CONFIDENCE` |  | `0.9` |  |
| `--budget` | `BUDGET` |  | `200` |  |
| `--search-ceiling` | `SEARCH_CEILING` |  | `40` | skip the variant search when the best draft scores above this (0: always search) |
| `--state` | `STATE` |  |  |  |
| `--events` | `EVENTS` |  |  |  |
| `--no-draft` |  |  |  |  |
| `--no-recipes` |  |  |  |  |
| `--draft-portfolio` |  |  |  | build several drafts (plain, with context, alternative m2c renderings) and continue from the closest |
| `--draft-options` | `DRAFT_OPTIONS` |  | `''` | comma-separated extra m2c renderings for the portfolio, e.g. --no-andor,--gotos-only |
| `--force` |  |  |  |  |

| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | toolchain root (default: N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  | `4` | compilers run at once |

## source-donor

Describe any C source tree as a donor for decompile-run --donors: its units, include directories, each unit's recipe and its configuration macros are found by building and comparing with the target, not read from its build files

```text
n64dk source-donor --source SOURCE --project PROJECT --out OUT [--run RUN] [--recipe 'PIPELINE FLAGS'] [--define NAME] [--max-macros MAX_MACROS] [--name NAME] [--min-shared N] [--units {split,whole,both}] [--whole-units] [--prepare-command SHELL] [--keep-work] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--jobs JOBS] [--wait-for-lock] [--force-resources]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--source` | `SOURCE` | yes |  | the source tree (any layout) |
| `--project` | `PROJECT` | yes |  | surveyed project of the target title (its functions are what the tree is compared with) |
| `--out` | `OUT` | yes |  | directory for the image, manifests and donors.toml |
| `--run` | `RUN` |  |  | a finished decompile-run of the target: the recipes it matched under are the candidates |
| `--recipe` | `'PIPELINE FLAGS'` |  |  | a candidate recipe (repeatable), e.g. 'ido5.3 -O2 -mips2' |
| `--define` | `NAME` |  |  | a configuration macro to set without measuring it (repeatable) |
| `--max-macros` | `MAX_MACROS` |  | `48` | configuration macros measured, most used first |
| `--name` | `NAME` |  |  | donor name (default: from the directory) |
| `--min-shared` | `N` |  |  | functions of the title the tree must give to be taken as a donor (default 8); lower it for a small tree whose recipe you state with --recipe |
| `--units` | `{split,whole,both}` |  | `'split'` | donor units: one per function (split, the default), the tree's own units (whole), or both as two donors (a function is then taken from whichever verifies) |
| `--whole-units` |  |  |  | keep the tree's own units as the donor's units (a unit is then taken only when all of it stands in the title, and its data comes with it); the default is one unit per function |
| `--prepare-command` | `SHELL` |  |  | run this in a copy of the tree before reading it (for headers the tree's own build generates, e.g. 'make NOEXTRACT=1 build/us/include/text_strings.h'); the tree is never written. Without it, missing generated files get stand-ins and functions that need them are refused by verification |
| `--keep-work` |  |  |  | keep the calibration's probe images |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | toolchain root (default: N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  | `2` | compilers run at once (capped by the machine's memory) |
| `--wait-for-lock` |  |  |  | wait for another heavy n64dk job to finish instead of refusing to start |
| `--force-resources` |  |  |  | start even when memory, memory pressure or disk space are below the thresholds |

## survey

Run every analysis over the program image; report.md, report.json and a ROM ledger

```text
n64dk survey rom --out OUT [--image {auto,static,emulated}] [--no-lzari-brute] [--require-complete]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rom` (positional) | `rom` | yes |  | ROM image (z64, v64 or n64 byte order) |
| `--out` | `OUT` | yes |  | output directory |
| `--image` | `{auto,static,emulated}` |  | `'auto'` | program image: emulate the boot only when a loader runs (auto), never, or always |
| `--no-lzari-brute` |  |  |  | probe LZARI only at loader-evidenced starts |
| `--require-complete` |  |  |  | exit with status 1 when any ROM byte is unknown (zero-unknown gate) |

## training-corpus-audit

Rebuild training pairs and check each still gives its target's bytes

```text
n64dk training-corpus-audit --corpus CORPUS [--sample SAMPLE] [--repair] [--wait-for-lock] [--force-resources] [--toolchain TOOLCHAIN]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--corpus` | `CORPUS` | yes |  |  |
| `--sample` | `SAMPLE` |  |  | audit this many pairs, evenly spread (default: every pair) |
| `--repair` |  |  |  | relabel pairs another function of their source reproduces; quarantine every other failure so it never reaches training or evaluation |
| `--wait-for-lock` |  |  |  | wait for another heavy n64dk job to finish instead of refusing to start |
| `--force-resources` |  |  |  | start even when memory, memory pressure or disk space are below the thresholds |
| `--toolchain` | `TOOLCHAIN` |  |  | toolchain root (default: $N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |

## training-corpus-build

Collect verified draft/source pairs of one title from an imported source tree

```text
n64dk training-corpus-build --project PROJECT --import-run IMPORT_RUN --donor-dir DONOR_DIR [--rom-run ROM_RUN] --out OUT [--conditions [{plain,context,recovered} ...]] [--draft-sample DRAFT_SAMPLE] [--jobs JOBS] [--wait-for-lock] [--force-resources] [--toolchain TOOLCHAIN]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `PROJECT` | yes |  | the title's project |
| `--import-run` | `IMPORT_RUN` | yes |  | decompile-run output that used the tree as donor |
| `--donor-dir` | `DONOR_DIR` | yes |  | the tree donor's folder (source-donor output) |
| `--rom-run` | `ROM_RUN` |  |  | a run of the same title without the tree, for what the ROM alone gave |
| `--out` | `OUT` | yes |  | corpus folder |
| `--conditions` | `[{plain,context,recovered} ...]` |  | `['plain', 'context']` | drafts made for each pair: plain (decompiler alone), context (the tree's own declarations), recovered (the kit's whole-program recovery of structures, globals and prototypes) |
| `--draft-sample` | `DRAFT_SAMPLE` |  |  | draft only this many pairs, evenly spread |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  | `2` |  |
| `--wait-for-lock` |  |  |  | wait for another heavy n64dk job to finish instead of refusing to start |
| `--force-resources` |  |  |  | start even when memory, memory pressure or disk space are below the thresholds |
| `--toolchain` | `TOOLCHAIN` |  |  | toolchain root (default: $N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |

## transplant-scan

Find target functions identical (relocations masked) to C matched in donor projects, transfer donor symbols, transplant and strictly verify the donor sources

```text
n64dk transplant-scan --rom ROM [--vram-delta VRAM_DELTA] --catalogue CATALOGUE [--manifest MANIFEST] [--symbols SYMBOLS] [--truth-manifest TRUTH_MANIFEST] --donors DONORS [--donor DONOR] [--exclude-donor EXCLUDE_DONOR] [--index INDEX] [--out OUT] [--toolchain-dir TOOLCHAIN_DIR] [--jobs JOBS] [--near NEAR] [--no-verify] [--full]
```

| argument | value | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rom` | `ROM` | yes |  | target image (ROM, or a linear image with --vram-delta) |
| `--vram-delta` | `VRAM_DELTA` |  |  | VRAM - file offset of the target code |
| `--catalogue` | `CATALOGUE` | yes |  | target function catalogue (recomp TOML, splat symbol_addrs with sizes, or ROM/SIZE/VRAM/NAME TSV) |
| `--manifest` | `MANIFEST` |  |  | already-matched rows of the target (ROM_START SIZE ...); overlapping functions are skipped |
| `--symbols` | `SYMBOLS` |  |  | target symbol file (precision report only) |
| `--truth-manifest` | `TRUTH_MANIFEST` |  |  | target manifests whose --symbol/--section-base addresses score transfer precision (not skipped) |
| `--donors` | `DONORS` | yes |  | donors TOML (see donors.example.toml) |
| `--donor` | `DONOR` |  |  | use only these donor names |
| `--exclude-donor` | `EXCLUDE_DONOR` |  |  | leave these donors out |
| `--index` | `INDEX` |  |  | donor index JSON (outside any game project; reused incrementally) |
| `--out` | `OUT` |  |  | output directory for candidate sources, proposed rows and symbols |
| `--toolchain-dir` | `TOOLCHAIN_DIR` |  |  | toolchain root (default: $N64DK_TOOLCHAIN) |
| `--jobs` | `JOBS` |  | `4` |  |
| `--near` | `NEAR` |  | `2` | report near hits with up to N differing words |
| `--no-verify` |  |  |  | scan and transfer only |
| `--full` |  |  |  | do not truncate lists in the printed report |
